claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Metoprolol is a hydrophilic beta1-selective adrenergic antagonist that is not cytotoxic at 2.5 uM; it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak antiproliferative signal reflecting non-specific beta-blocker/lysosomotropic effects rather than a bona fide cytotoxic mechanism.
